title: Drag to Assign
description: The whole point of the Kanban board (FR-901) is that dragging a shipment card onto a vehicle column is the assignment — no form, no extra click. Prove the drag itself does the job.
successCondition: Dragging a shipment card from the "Unassigned" column and dropping it onto a specific vehicle's column results in: the card no longer appearing in "Unassigned", the same shipment id now appearing in that vehicle's column, the vehicle lane's shipment count incrementing by one, and a corresponding row appearing in the Schedule table below with that vehicle and the currently-selected driver.
hints: Dispatch real dragstart/dragover/drop events carrying the custom MIME type application/x-swiftcargo-shipment-id — a plain click won't trigger the handlers.
Pick a driver and slot start in the form above the board before dragging — the drop handler reads those values at drop time.
